name: hextitanium-bolt-system
description: Hex Titanium Local Web-Based Bolt Specification System

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.test:docker: docker compose -p hextitanium-test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-api
